title: Capacity slicing scenarios & customer tiling matrix (May 2027)
summary: Working spreadsheet for per-contract capacity phasing across regions with three supply/demand scenarios (baseline, high-growth, emergency fallback). Includes effective A100-equivalent normalization, pooling windows, and recommended holdback for SLA contingency.
content:
Sheet: Capacity slices (contracts x regions) - May 2027

Columns: Contract_ID | Customer | Region | HW_Family | Reserved_GPUs | Reserved_A100_equiv | Perf_factor | Reservation_start | Phase_months | Baseline_util% | Peak_util% | Baseline_effective_A100 | HighGrowth_effective_A100 | Fallback_pool_holdback | Notes

Row examples:

C-7422 | EduNLP | eu-central1 | A100-40GB | 6 | =6 * 0.55 | 0.55 | 2027-09-01 | 2 | 20 | 45 | =3.3*0.20 | =3.3*0.45 | 0 | Short PoC contract, flexible.

Scenario definitions:
- Baseline: expected demand from customer SLOs and historical utilization patterns. Use Baseline_util% to compute sustained effective A100 load.
- HighGrowth: 1.2x-1.5x uplift on Baseline for onboarding, model updates, or unexpected adoption. Use Peak_util% column for short windows.
- Emergency fallback: cluster-level pooling where critical customers may borrow from region emergency pool; matrix defines per-contract minimum holdback (Fallback_pool_holdback) in GPU units.

Derived columns logic (for spreadsheet team):
- Reserved_A100_equiv = Reserved_GPUs * Perf_factor (normalize H100->A100 equiv)
- Baseline_effective_A100 = Reserved_A100_equiv * Baseline_util%
- HighGrowth_effective_A100 = Reserved_A100_equiv * Peak_util%

Regional pool planning (summary rows):
Region: us-west1 | Total_reserved_A100_equiv = sum(Reserved_A100_equiv for region) | Baseline_demand = sum(Baseline_effective_A100) | Headroom_baseline = Total_reserved - Baseline_demand | Recommended_holdback = max(ceil(0.07 * Total_reserved), max(Fallback_pool_holdback for contracts in region))
Region: eu-west1 | same calc...
Region: ap-southeast2 | same calc...
Region: eu-central1 | same calc...

Cost/ops note: convert effective A100 to cost-run units when handing off to finance: monthly_cost_estimate = Baseline_effective_A100 * price_per_A100_hour * avg_hours_per_month (price_per_A100_hour inserted from finance sheet).

Pool tiling proposals (scenarios):
- Conservative tiling: holdback 10% per region, strict pinning for customers with SLO>99.9.
- Efficiency tiling: holdback 4%, allow preemption on batch jobs across dedicated clusters; potential 6% cost saving but increases fallback risk.
- Hybrid: per-region holdback = 7% + 1 GPU slack for each contract with burst_window > 3 months.
